name: workflow-adapter
description: Agent team workflow plugin for brainstorming, planning, execution, QA, TDD, and review workflows across Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Team-style development workflows for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Adapter provides structured skills for brainstorming, planning, execution, investigation, QA, TDD, pull request preparation, and multi-agent coordination. The original Claude Code manifests remain intact, while the Codex manifest exposes the shared skill set with compatibility guidance for Codex-native tools.
defaultPrompt: Run a team-loop investigation for this bug.
Create a plan from the latest brainstorming notes.
Use TDD to implement this feature.
